# Our World in Data

> > Research and data to make progress against the world's largest problems

Our World in Data provides open-access research, interactive data visualizations, and evidence-based articles on global challenges including poverty, health, energy, climate change, and demographics. Founded by Max Roser and team including Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado, the platform tracks UN Sustainable Development Goals and publishes data-driven analysis on critical global issues.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Energy transition and clean energy
- Critical minerals (lithium, copper, cobalt)
- Population growth and demographics
- Global poverty reduction
- Public health and disease prevention
- Climate change and environmental sustainability
- Mental health and psychiatric classification
- Tobacco harm reduction and vaping
- Antibiotic resistance
- COVID-19 pandemic data
- Neglected tropical diseases
- Renewable energy access
- Mining and mineral reserves

## Sustainable Development Goals Tracking

- [End poverty in all its forms everywhere](https://ourworldindata.org/sdgs/no-poverty): UN SDG 1 tracker for extreme poverty and poverty indicators globally
- [Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all](https://ourworldindata.org/sdgs/affordable-clean-energy): UN SDG 7 tracker for clean energy access and renewable energy

## Energy Transition and Critical Minerals

- [Metals and Minerals](https://ourworldindata.org/metals-minerals): Critical minerals production data and trends for energy transition
- [Which countries have the critical minerals needed for the energy transition?](https://ourworldindata.org/countries-critical-minerals-needed-energy-transition): Distribution of critical minerals for clean energy by country

## Global Health and Disease

- [Key lessons from our work on the COVID-19 pandemic are now published in Lancet Public Health](https://ourworldindata.org/key-lessons-from-our-work-on-the-covid-19-pandemic-are-now-published-in-lancet-public-health): Lancet publication on COVID-19 data publishing best practices
- [While vaping is not risk-free, it is less harmful than tobacco](https://ourworldindata.org/vaping-vs-smoking-health-risks): FAQ article comparing health risks of vaping vs smoking tobacco
- [What was the Golden Age of Antibiotics, and how can we spark a new one?](https://ourworldindata.org/golden-age-antibiotics): History of antibiotic development from penicillin to resistance challenges
- [How are mental illnesses defined?](https://ourworldindata.org/how-are-mental-illnesses-defined): Explainer on psychiatric classification systems ICD-11 and DSM-5
- [How Wolbachia bacteria could help us tackle some of the world's most neglected tropical diseases](https://ourworldindata.org/wolbachia-neglected-tropical-diseases): Wolbachia bacteria method for reducing dengue and tropical diseases

## Demographics and Population

- [Population Growth](https://ourworldindata.org/population-growth): Global and national population growth data and demographic trends
